statement: Mean annual warming is projected at 1.1–3.0°C by the 2060s and 1.6–5.3°C by the 2090s, fastest in the north and northwest; 2041–50 dry/hot and wet/warm cases differ in both temperature and rainfall.
compact_statement: Mean annual warming is projected at 1.1–3.0°C by the 2060s and 1.6–5.3°C by the 2090s, fastest in the north and northwest; 2041–50 dry/hot and wet/warm cases differ in both temperature and rainfall.
scenario: Profile ranges to 2060s/2090s; dry/hot and wet/warm cases compare 2041-50 with 1995-2020; rainfall uncertain.

source_refs.locator: Section 1.2, printed p. 19 (PDF p. 19), climate-risk profile and scenario tables.

uncertainty: The passage notes significant uncertainty in precipitation changes.

statement: Without accelerated adaptation, modelled 2050 GDP losses reach 11.6% under dry/hot conditions and 2.5% under wet/warm conditions.
compact_statement: Without accelerated adaptation, modelled 2050 GDP losses reach 11.6% under dry/hot conditions and 2.5% under wet/warm conditions.
scenario: CCDR macroeconomic pathways and climate scenarios; cited dry/hot and wet/warm results are without accelerated adaptation.

source_refs.locator: Section 1.2, printed p. 19 (PDF p. 19), CC-MFMod results under dry/hot and wet/warm climate scenarios.

uncertainty: Modelled scenario estimates, not observed GDP losses.

statement: The CCDR states that climate impacts aggravate Guinea’s fragility; it also identifies insecure tenure and land issues among fragility drivers linked in the report to rural poverty, gender inequality, and intercommunal violence.
compact_statement: The CCDR states that climate impacts aggravate Guinea’s fragility; it also identifies insecure tenure and land issues among fragility drivers linked in the report to rural poverty, gender inequality, and intercommunal violence.
scenario: Qualitative country assessment; no climate scenario or dated projection is specified in this passage.

source_refs.locator: Printed p. 18 (PDF p. 18), discussion of fragility, governance, land issues, and intercommunal violence.

uncertainty: Qualitative framing; the passage does not estimate a causal climate effect on violence.
